# H1 follow-up proposal

`plan.json` is an offline pre-freeze proposal, not a live sampling entrypoint.
It preserves fair A's common prompts, fixtures, assertions, model settings and
counterbalanced four-Session/two-Turn schedule. Only the JS entry guidance changes.
The referenced fair A manifest and harness remain historical frozen evidence.

H1 tests known-name discovery and same-Session schema reuse. First Turn: exactly
one describe per selected Context7 tool, no search for those names. Continuation:
no repeated describe or search. No search/describe shape errors. These criteria
are separate from business and token targets. Native schemas remain directly
callable; a genuine invalidation must still reject old bindings before effect.

The plan declares zero additional main requests as the per-Turn/per-pair target.
Fresh cost is reported per Turn and pair, as both absolute and relative deltas;
non-increase has zero tolerance. Strict savings requires both pairs and the
aggregate to improve with complete provider usage. No retries or revised targets
can replace the original result. A mechanism pass alone proves no savings.

Before running, coordinate authorization and freeze a new harness, exact product
head and manifest hash. Do not run the old fair A harness under a changed prompt
or describe this proposal as an executed comparison. File capability B remains
separate. H2 output selection/aggregation changes are excluded.

For the current canonical lookup implementation, run
`bash app/gatewayapp/testdata/code-mode/h1-plan/reproduce-lookup-offline.sh`.
It checks indexed and enumeration-only Sources in a bounded N=2 smoke,
checks real local MCP Manager behavior and authority boundaries, and preserves
fresh evidence without contacting a provider model. The earlier H1 head is
historical; a future sampling manifest must bind the new reviewed product head.

Definition counts are internal local-cost diagnostics, not the primary product
benefit criterion. The archived N=2/20/200/2000 matrix remains evidence of the
bounded optimization; do not extend it as a performance study. Real-model
business success, round trips and provider token usage remain the main targets.
